lesson.title: Springs and Momentum - Past AP Physics 1 Example

segments.text: The 2024 AP Physics 1 exam has a couple of questions that relate to oscillations, pendulums, and springs, so I will be going over these in a few videos. The student places a motion detector to the right of the cart, as shown in Figure 2, and pulls the cart to the right a small distance so that the spring is stretched.
